title: 虛擬機監控器
summary: 以客體執行、第二層翻譯與資源界線連結 16 個技術單元，新增 32 步原理、架構、假想算例、實驗設計與失效驗證。
summaryEn: Sixteen technical units connect guest execution, second-level translation and resource boundaries through 32 new tasks covering principles, architecture, assumed calculations, experiment design and failure validation.

stages.title: 主客體與 vCPU

stages.descriptionEn: Four technical units develop hosts, guests and vcpus through separate principle/architecture and experiment/validation tasks with saved progress and knowledge checks.

steps.title: 主客體邊界：原理與架構
steps.objective: 以「主客體邊界」建立可檢查的架構、原理與驗證依據。
steps.objectiveEn: Establish reviewable architecture, principles and evidence for host/guest boundaries.
steps.instruction: 先觀看師傅示意，辨識「主客體邊界」的資料、控制與時間關係。客體核心特權受 hypervisor 控制。 在離線工作臺畫出元件／資料流，列出輸入、輸出、保存狀態與合法轉移；建立基準與擾動兩種假想情境，寫下可被反駁的預測。以「標出 host、VMM 與 guest。」設計下一步驗證。記錄版本、單位、未知參數與模型外的行為。
steps.instructionEn: Watch the mentor and identify data, control and timing relationships for host/guest boundaries. Guest kernel privilege is controlled by the hypervisor. Draw components/data flows offline; specify inputs, outputs, retained state and legal transitions. Build baseline and perturbed hypothetical cases and make a falsifiable prediction. Plan validation using: Mark host, VMM and guest. Record versions, units, unknowns and out-of-model behavior.
steps.observation: 標出 host、VMM 與 guest。
steps.failure: 常見誤判：VM 數增加就會增加實體 CPU 算力。 本步需分開功能正確、資源上界與證據範圍，不可把假想結果當作真實平臺保證。
steps.failureEn: Common mistake: More VMs create more physical CPU compute. Separate correctness, resource bounds and evidence scope; hypothetical results are not real-platform guarantees.
steps.check: 提交「主客體邊界」的兩情境架構／狀態圖、參數表與可反駁預測；標出哪些資料支援「客體核心特權受 hypervisor 控制。」。

knowledge.title: 本課原創量化算例
knowledge.text: 假設 2 MiB huge page 與 4 KiB 小頁覆蓋相同 1 GiB：需要 512 個 huge pages 或 262,144 小頁，數量相差 512 倍。頁表量與 TLB 觸及非直接同倍保證，另有碎片及權限粒度成本。

workedExample.title: 原創可重算假想案例
workedExample.text: 假設 2 MiB huge page 與 4 KiB 小頁覆蓋相同 1 GiB：需要 512 個 huge pages 或 262,144 小頁，數量相差 512 倍。頁表量與 TLB 觸及非直接同倍保證，另有碎片及權限粒度成本。
workedExample.textEn: For 1 GiB, 2 MiB pages need 512 pages versus 262,144 pages of 4 KiB: a 512-fold count difference. Page-table size/TLB reach do not guarantee equal gains; fragmentation and permission granularity matter.
workedExample.assumptions: 使用算例明列的單位、邊界與理想化前提；改變版本、工作負載、故障模型或資源條件後重算。
workedExample.assumptionsEn: Use the stated units, boundaries and idealizations; recalculate after version, workload, fault-model or resource changes.
workedExample.sourceScope: 作者原創算例；官方來源支援原理與背景，不是這組數字的實測來源。
workedExample.sourceScopeEn: Original assumed example; official sources support principles/context, not measurements of these numbers.
